'''Ackrahbala''', locally known as "'''Crazy 'Bala'''," was a [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] who lived in [[Bartyn's Landing]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Sometime around [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], he owned and operated the business [[Ackrahbala's Swoops & Speeders]].<ref name="Bartyn's Landing" />

==Personality and traits==
He was energetic and always wanted to close a deal.<ref name="Bartyn's Landing" />
